referenceSources.description:
A lightweight Volkswagen Lupo, built by ABT for the ADAC Junior Cup, is staged on a winding hillclimb course. The car’s white body is accented by a black-and-white checkered roof, red mirrors, and gold racing wheels. Number 497 is prominently displayed on the doors alongside sponsor decals from ProMetal and Bitburger 0,0. Inside, a red safety net and full roll cage hint at its FIA-compliant safety equipment.

Under the hood lies a 4-cylinder, 16-valve VW AFH engine managed by DTA Fast electronics, paired with a dogbox 5-speed gearbox and lamellar differential lock. The chassis weighs just 800 kg and rides on adjustable Bilstein/H&R suspension. Braking duties are handled by AP Racing calipers up front and ATE discs at the rear. Additional features include an Innovate LC-2 lambda controller, FIA-approved safety tank, and a MOMO racing seat with Takata harness.
